_comment: Abstract-deadline feed for Research Tracker. The biweekly scheduled task rewrites this file after checking each society. The app fetches it on load and merges any entry whose verifiedOn is newer. 'key' must stay stable so updates match the right meeting. Set unconfirmed=false only when a date is verified from the society's official call for abstracts.

meetings.name: 2027 Annual Meeting
meetings.dates: Mar 3–6, 2027 (paper/poster/ePoster abstracts due 6/8, extended; OVT 7/15; OrthoDome 8/31)

meetings.name: Orthopaedic Video Theater (OVT) Submission
meetings.dates: Video submissions due July 15, 2026 (peer-reviewed; presented at 2027 Annual Meeting; eligible for award designation and JAAOS video abstract inclusion)

meetings.name: OrthoDome® Video Submission
meetings.dates: OrthoDome video applications due August 31, 2026; non-CME, 7–12 min surgical technique videos narrated live at the 2027 Annual Meeting

meetings.name: 2027 Annual Meeting
meetings.dates: Podium/E-presentation abstracts due 8/23/2026 (extended from 8/10); Diplomat Beach Resort, Hollywood, FL (exact meeting dates TBA)

meetings.name: 18th ISHA Annual Scientific Meeting
meetings.dates: Bruges, Belgium, 8–10 Oct 2026 (pre-conference day 7 Oct). Abstract & award-application window closed (opened 1 Jan, closed 13 Apr 2026). ISHA — The Hip Preservation Society's flagship international hip arthroscopy/preservation congress; host country rotates each year (has been held in North America in past cycles).

meetings.name: 22nd ESSKA Congress
meetings.dates: Prague, Czech Republic, 20–22 May 2026 (theme "History meets Science"). Abstract submission closed 22 Sept 2025; congress has concluded. ESSKA (European Society for Sports Traumatology, Knee Surgery & Arthroscopy — publisher of the KSSTA journal) holds its congress biennially; next edition (~2028) not yet announced.

meetings.name: International Congress on Shoulder and Elbow Surgery (ICSES) 2026
meetings.dates: Vancouver, BC, Canada, 22–25 Sept 2026 (ASES International Day 22 Sept). Abstract submission closed 19 Jan 2026; acceptance notifications sent 30 Apr 2026; manuscript deadline for podium presenters 12 Aug 2026. Triennial global shoulder & elbow congress jointly hosted by international shoulder societies including ASES; ~2,000 attendees from 60+ countries expected.

meetings.name: SECEC-ESSSE Congress 2026
meetings.dates: Barcelona, Spain, 2–4 Sept 2026. Abstract submission window 17 Dec 2025 – 11 Feb 2026 (closed); acceptance notifications 29 Apr 2026. Europe's leading shoulder & elbow congress (Société Européenne pour la Chirurgie de l'Épaule et du Coude / European Society for Surgery of the Shoulder and the Elbow).

meetings.name: ASES 2027 Annual Meeting
meetings.dates: National Harbor, MD (Gaylord National Resort & Convention Center), 13–16 Oct 2027. Abstract submission window not yet announced. (ASES also participates in ICSES 2026 in Vancouver — see separate entry — and runs an ASES Winter Summit Open Meeting 16–19 Feb 2027 in Hollywood, FL, which is not an abstract-driven scientific meeting.)

meetings.name: 2027 ISAKOS Congress
meetings.dates: Sydney, Australia, 30 May – 2 June 2027. Abstract submission closed 4 Aug 2026, 11:59pm PDT; acceptance/rejection notifications by 30 Dec 2026. International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine's biennial world congress.

meetings.name: 19th World Congress
meetings.dates: May 1–3, 2027, Rotterdam; registration now open; abstract call not yet open (more details to follow)

meetings.name: 2027 Annual Meeting
meetings.dates: 2027 Annual Meeting abstract/IC submissions open 7/15/2026, close 9/9/2026 (decisions ~Dec 2026); Specialty Day abstracts closed (notifications Aug 2026); Specialty Day Mar 5, 2027

meetings.name: Annual Meeting
meetings.dates: Members-only; no public deadline

meetings.name: OREF Clinical Research Award
meetings.aim: Supports clinical research that advances patient care across orthopaedic subspecialties.
meetings.criteria: $20,000 award. Application deadline 7/1/2026 (no LOI). See the OREF RFA for eligibility and proposal requirements; apply via proposalCENTRAL.

meetings.name: Mentored Clinician Scientist Grant
meetings.dates: $20,000 · requires K award · RFA released 3/23/2026
meetings.aim: Helps clinician-scientists who already hold a 'K' award build toward independent research funding.
meetings.criteria: $20,000. Applicant must have been awarded an NIH 'K' (career development) award to apply. Application deadline 6/24/2026 (no LOI).

meetings.name: Resident Research Project Grant
meetings.dates: $5,000 · RFA released 3/23/2026
meetings.aim: Funds focused research projects led by orthopaedic residents.
meetings.criteria: $5,000. For orthopaedic residents. LOI due 4/22/2026; application deadline 6/24/2026.

meetings.key: OREF|Resident Clinician Scientist Training Research Grant
meetings.name: Resident Clinician Scientist Training Research Grant
meetings.aim: Supports orthopaedic residents pursuing clinician-scientist training through a mentored research project.
meetings.criteria: $20,000. For orthopaedic residents in clinician-scientist training. LOI due 4/22/2026; application deadline 6/24/2026. See OREF RFA on proposalCENTRAL.

meetings.name: ORS/OREF Distinguished Investigator Award
meetings.dates: Honorary · RFA released 6/1/2026
meetings.aim: Honors an investigator for sustained, distinguished contributions to musculoskeletal research.
meetings.criteria: Honorary award (joint with ORS). Nomination-based; application deadline 9/11/2026.

meetings.name: OREF Career Development Grant
meetings.dates: $300,000 over three years · new 2027 Round 1 program · RFA released 7/15/2026
meetings.aim: Encourages investigators to commit to scientific research that may be basic, translational, clinical, and/or health sciences.
meetings.criteria: $300,000 over three years. An orthopaedic surgeon must serve as PI, co-investigator, or MPI, licensed to practice and working in a U.S. institution; a PhD may serve as co-PI/MPI if holding a faculty appointment in a U.S. orthopaedic department. LOI due 8/13/2026; application deadline 10/15/2026. Full eligibility on the RFA via proposalCENTRAL.

meetings.key: OREF|John W. Brown Early-Stage Investigator Grant
meetings.name: OREF/John W. Brown Early-Stage Investigator Enabling Technologies in Musculoskeletal Care Research Grant
meetings.dates: $100,000 · new 2027 Round 1 program · RFA released 7/15/2026
meetings.aim: Solicits investigator-initiated research on enabling technologies in musculoskeletal health care; honors former Stryker CEO John W. Brown. Preference for innovative technologies with expected clinical benefit.
meetings.criteria: $100,000. PI must be an early-stage investigator (completed terminal research degree or post-graduate clinical training within the past 10 years, no prior successful NIH R01-equivalent as PI). An orthopaedic surgeon must be part of the project as PI, co-PI, co-I, or MPI. LOI due 8/13/2026; application deadline 10/15/2026.

meetings.name: OREF New Investigator Grant
meetings.dates: $50,000 · new 2027 Round 1 program · RFA released 7/15/2026
meetings.aim: Advances the scientific training of the next generation of orthopaedic clinician scientists via seed and start-up funding.
meetings.criteria: $50,000. PI must be an orthopaedic surgeon licensed and working in a U.S. institution; residents, fellows, and surgeons who completed formal training within the last 4 years may apply. LOI due 8/13/2026; application deadline 10/15/2026.

meetings.key: OREF|Multimodal Musculoskeletal Perioperative Pain Management Grant
meetings.name: OREF Multimodal Musculoskeletal Perioperative Pain Management Grant
meetings.dates: $45,000 · in collaboration with the American Association of Nurse Anesthetists (AANA) Foundation — not to be confused with the Arthroscopy Association of North America · new 2027 Round 1 program · RFA released 7/15/2026
meetings.aim: Funds investigator-initiated research on perioperative musculoskeletal pain management, including opioid-sparing multimodal techniques and regional anesthesia approaches.
meetings.criteria: $45,000. PI or co-PI must be a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) in good standing with NBCRNA, optionally with a collaborating PhD and/or MD; a PhD may serve as PI if a CRNA serves as co-PI. LOI due 8/13/2026; application deadline 10/15/2026.

meetings.name: AOSSM-AF Hip Osteoarthritis Grant (Full)
meetings.dates: up to $250,000 (1–3 grants)
meetings.aim: Funds studies on hip pathology and the rapid development of osteoarthritis that can grow into externally-fundable research programs.
meetings.criteria: In collaboration with the Arthritis Foundation; up to three grants of $250,000 each. Must address an important clinical problem in hip pathology/PTOA and aim to establish a programmatic line of research competitive for NIH/PCORI/DOD funding. LOI due 4/17; full proposals due 6/26/2026.
funded: Sex-specific molecular and mechanical factors in cartilage injury — Paula Hernandez, PhD (2022)
Delivery of chondrogenic genes for articular cartilage repair — Christopher Nagelli, PhD (2021)
Mechanical Loading Effects in OA Progression Following ACL Reconstruction — Camila B. Carballo, PT, PhD (2019)

meetings.name: Sandy Kirkley Clinical Outcomes Grant
meetings.aim: Provides seed or supplemental funding for an outcomes research project or pilot study, honoring Dr. Kirkley's advocacy for rigorous RCTs.
meetings.criteria: $25,000 start-up seed or supplemental funding for an outcome research project or pilot study in orthopaedic sports medicine. Submission deadline 7/31/2026.
funded: Extended Post-Operative Oral TXA after ACLR: A Multicenter RCT — David Bernholt, MD (2025)
Arthroscopic Distal Tibia Allograft vs Latarjet for Subcritical Bone Loss — Ivan Wong, MD (2024)
Evaluating the Efficacy of Erector Spinae Block in Routine Hip Arthroscopy — Benjamin Coobs, MD (2022)

meetings.name: AOSSM-JRF Ortho Allograft Grant
meetings.aim: Advances insight into meniscal or osteochondral allograft transplantation of the knee.
meetings.criteria: In coordination with JRF Ortho; up to $50,000 for a basic science or clinical project on viable osteochondral (OCA) or meniscus allograft transplantation of the knee. Translational/clinical-care advances reviewed favorably. Deadline 8/1/2026.
funded: Understanding OCA structure and matrix nanomechanics to improve integration — Paula Hernandez, PhD (2025)
Biomechanics of segmental meniscus transplant: a human cadaveric study — Alvin Su, MD, PhD (2024)
Nonorthotopic osteochondral allograft transplantation to the femoral head — Christopher Nagelli, PhD (2023)

meetings.name: Arnoczky Young Investigator Grant (Full)
meetings.dates: $40,000 basic + $40,000 clinical
meetings.aim: Supports early-career principal investigators leading an orthopaedic sports medicine research project, with mentorship.
meetings.criteria: Up to $40,000 each for one clinical and one basic science project ($80,000 total). A Young Investigator is an orthopaedic surgeon who has graduated from or is currently in an approved residency program; the PI must perform the primary project role, remain at the parent institution for the project period, and have received less than $25,000 in external funding. Pre-proposals due 5/15; full proposals due 9/20/2026.
funded: Artificial Intelligence for Data and Insights in Young Hip (AIDY) — Yining Lu, MD (2024, Clinical)
Analysis of Noninvasive Biomarkers for ACL Reconstruction — Luke Troyer, MD (2024, Basic)
Sex Differences in FAIS Hip Synovium Leading to Differences in Outcomes — Stephanie Wong, MD (2023, Basic)

meetings.name: Playmaker Grant Lab
meetings.dates: $25,000 each (1–2 grants); LOI due 5/15/2026 (closed); finalists present at the Annual Meeting
meetings.aim: Provides start-up, seed, bridge/gap, or supplemental funding to advance exploratory projects on emerging or novel technology in orthopaedic sports medicine.
meetings.criteria: Sponsored by The Aircast Foundation and Haslam Sports Innovation Center. Three-phase process: 2-page LOI (Phase 1, due 5/15/2026), a ≤15-minute presentation to the AOSSM Research Committee at the Annual Meeting (Phase 2), then a formal AOSSM-format grant application for funded projects (Phase 3). Studies involving human subjects receive priority.
funded: Virtual Reality as a Prevention Tool for Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury — Estephania Nunez, DAT (2025)
Dislocation- and Surgery-Induced Plasticity of the Glenoid Track — Jonathan Hughes, MD (2025)
Valgus Force on the UCL During Batter's Swing and Hitting Motion — Bradley A. Lezak, MD (2025)

meetings.name: 2026 MAST Research Initiative Grant
meetings.dates: $150,000 total funding pool · new joint AOSSM/AANA/SOMOS grant
meetings.aim: Funds orthopaedic research relevant to the military or general population, jointly sponsored by AOSSM, AANA, and the Society of Military Orthopaedic Surgeons (SOMOS).
meetings.criteria: New for 2026. $150,000 total funding pool. Joint initiative among AOSSM, the Arthroscopy Association of North America (AANA), and the Society of Military Orthopaedic Surgeons (SOMOS) for research pertaining to the military population or general population. Apply via Proposal Central by 8/7/2026.

meetings.name: AANA Research Grant
meetings.dates: 2027 cycle: multiple awards $25,000–$50,000 per funded project
meetings.aim: Funds high-quality clinical and basic science research advancing arthroscopic surgery and disorders amenable to arthroscopic treatment.
meetings.criteria: All orthopaedic research projects welcome. For 2027, AANA will offer multiple awards ranging from $25,000 to $50,000 per funded project. Evaluated on significance/impact, scientific approach, investigative team/environment, feasibility, and budget. Application deadline Wednesday, September 30, 2026, 11:59pm CT. Apply via AANA research grants portal.

meetings.name: OREF/AAOS Clinical Gaps Research Grant
meetings.dates: Administered via OREF — not on current OREF open/upcoming list; cycle dates TBA
meetings.aim: Supports investigator-initiated research addressing clinical gaps in healing, repair, or diagnostics through devices, biologics, or technology.
meetings.criteria: Administered via OREF. Translational, preclinical, or clinical research, preferably including pilot human studies. Cycle dates TBA — confirm on the OREF funding page.

meetings.name: NIH Research Project Grant (Parent R01)
meetings.dates: Standard NIH due dates, 3 cycles/year — new applications: Feb 5, Jun 5, Oct 5; renewal/resubmission/revision: Mar 5, Jul 5, Nov 5. Next new-application deadline Oct 5, 2026 (renewal/resubmission Nov 5, 2026). Two companion FOAs: PA-25-305 (clinical trial required) and PA-25-301 (clinical trial not allowed); both expire 1/8/2028. NIAMS (musculoskeletal/orthopaedic) is a participating institute.
meetings.aim: Broad, unsolicited investigator-initiated research support across NIH's mission — the standard mechanism for an independent MSK/orthopaedic research program, funded through whichever institute (e.g., NIAMS) is relevant to the science.
meetings.criteria: No topic restriction. Standard NIH eligibility — domestic and foreign higher-ed, nonprofit, for-profit, and government organizations; any PI with the expertise/resources to lead the work. No hard budget cap, but detailed (non-modular) budgets are required above $500,000 direct costs/year and need prior IC approval. Confirm your target institute (e.g., NIAMS) is listed as a participating organization before submitting. Apply via NIH ASSIST or Grants.gov Workspace.

meetings.name: NIH Exploratory/Developmental Research Project Grant (Parent R21)
meetings.dates: Standard NIH due dates, 3 cycles/year — new applications: Feb 16, Jun 16, Oct 16; renewal/resubmission/revision: Mar 16, Jul 16, Nov 16. Next new-application deadline Oct 16, 2026 (renewal/resubmission Nov 16, 2026). Two companion FOAs: PA-25-306 (clinical trial required) and PA-25-304 (clinical trial not allowed); both expire 1/8/2028. NIAMS (musculoskeletal/orthopaedic) is a participating institute.
meetings.aim: Supports early-stage, high-risk/high-reward exploratory or developmental research (e.g., pilot or proof-of-concept MSK/orthopaedic studies) that doesn't yet have the preliminary data needed for an R01.
meetings.criteria: Combined direct costs may not exceed $275,000 over the project period, with no more than $200,000 in any single year; project period capped at 2 years. Standard NIH eligibility (same organization types as the parent R01). Confirm your target institute (e.g., NIAMS) is listed as a participating organization before submitting.

meetings.key: NIAMS|Clinical Observational Studies in MSK Rheumatic Skin Disease (R01)
meetings.name: NIAMS Clinical Observational (CO) Studies in Musculoskeletal, Rheumatic, and Skin Diseases (R01)
meetings.dates: PAR-24-280. Final application cycle before the FOA expires — new/resubmission due Nov 2, 2026 (earlier 2026 cycles were Mar 4 and Jul 2). Expiration date Nov 3, 2026, unless NIAMS reissues the PAR.
meetings.aim: Funds non-interventional clinical observational studies (not clinical trials) in musculoskeletal, rheumatic, or skin disease/conditions to generate the data (outcome measures, biomarkers, disease-progression timing, recruitment feasibility) needed to design a future clinical study.
meetings.criteria: R01; direct costs capped at $475,000 over up to 4 years, no more than $250,000 in any single year. New and resubmission applications only. Only observational (non-interventional) studies are responsive — basic/animal research, disease-mechanism studies, any NIH-defined clinical trial, and early-stage biomarker discovery are non-responsive and returned without review. U.S. domestic organizations only (foreign components allowed within a U.S. award; foreign organizations cannot apply directly). NIAMS has a dedicated Orthopaedics scientific contact (Chuck Washabaugh, PhD, washabac@mail.nih.gov).

meetings.name: ORS 2027 Annual Meeting
meetings.dates: Moscone West Convention Center, San Francisco, CA, Feb 19–23, 2027. Abstract submission deadline Aug 31, 2026 (last day to edit); acceptance notices sent Nov 4, 2026. Orthopaedic Research Society flagship annual meeting for musculoskeletal basic/translational research.

meetings.name: 2027 ISHA Annual Scientific Meeting
meetings.dates: Ottawa, Canada, 16–18 Sept 2027 (date changed from original announcement to avoid conflicting events). Abstract call not yet open. ISHA — The Hip Preservation Society is the leading hip arthroscopy/preservation congress.

meetings.name: Vail Hip Summit
meetings.dates: Annual hip preservation meeting hosted by the Steadman Philippon Research Institute in Vail, CO; ISHA – The Hip Preservation Society-approved meeting. 2026 edition held April 9–11, 2026 (abstract submissions accepted; specific deadline not published). 2027 dates and call for abstracts not yet announced.
